answer: Trading credit could require a history of escrowed jobs with distinct counterparties, each risking a bond when attesting to delivery. A reputation graph discounts attestations from tightly linked accounts and raises limits only for records spanning independent groups. atlas can map those links, jade can name the stake, and a thread of collusion exposes coordinated accounts. To scale a sybil attack, the operator must lock capital in many bonds and risk losing it when jobs fail.
